hebrewText: וַ/יְחַלֵּ֨ק לְ/כָל הָ/עָ֜ם לְ/כָל הֲמ֣וֹן יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ לְ/מֵ/אִ֣ישׁ וְ/עַד אִשָּׁה֒ לְ/אִ֗ישׁ חַלַּ֥ת לֶ֨חֶם֙ אַחַ֔ת וְ/אֶשְׁפָּ֣ר אֶחָ֔ד וַ/אֲשִׁישָׁ֖ה אֶחָ֑ת וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם אִ֥ישׁ לְ/בֵיתֽ/וֹ

tokens.bdb: to be smooth (figuratively); by implication (as smooth stones were used for lots) to apportion or separate
tokens.kjv: deal, distribute, divide, flatter, give, (have, im-) part(-ner), take away a portion, receive, separate self, (be) smooth(-er).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to be smooth ; by implication  to apportion or separate
tokens.enLiteralWord: to be smooth ; by implication  to apportion or separate
tokens.explanation: to be smooth ; by implication  to apportion or separate
tokens.explanationEn: to be smooth ; by implication  to apportion or separate

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).
tokens.explanation: kol — todo, toda, qualquer, totalidade de algo

tokens.bdb: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
